page.overview:
Who is Desmond Otham?

Desmond Otham was the carriage driver for the Briarwoods until he was captured and imprisoned by Vox Machina. When the de Rolos restored their rule in Whitestone, Percy granted him the position of a messenger between Whitestone and Emon. As an NPC in campaign one, Desmond was played by Matthew Mercer. In The Legend of Vox Machina he is voiced by Max Mittelman.

In confrontation with Percy, Desmond lost a large part of the upper part of his right hand and most of his fingers (index, middle and ring). After Pike healed him with her divine magic, the wound closed entirely, and the thumb and pinky grew complete and functional.

His father was a messenger during the de Rolo's rule. He vanished on the night of their fall. His mother was taken by madness and passed away in 810 PD. Since Desmond possessed a decent knowledge of the roads between Whitestone and Emon, he was hired as a coachman for Count Tylieri, who misused the power and titles that the Briarwoods gifted unto him by abusing his staff and many citizens of Whitestone, including a teenaged Desmond. After seeing the harm Tylieri had wrought, Sylas Briarwood took the boy under his wing, hiring him as a coach for him and his wife.

Seriously hurt in their fight with Vox Machina at the Palace of the Sovereign, the Briarwoods attempted to escape via the carriage, which Desmond was driving. The party toppled the carriage, but the Briarwoods managed to teleport away. In anger, Percy shot off Desmond's hand and knocked him unconscious to further interrogate him at Greyskull Keep.
